changes.detail: New projects start on Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 and the @elysia plugins' release candidates, with @absolutejs/absolute 0.20.0-beta.144, @absolutejs/auth 0.101.0 and @absolutejs/observability 0.7.0, which build against it. The generated server registers its error handler with `onError` (Elysia rc.0 renamed `error`). Version lookups for Elysia packages now follow npm's `rc` tag instead of fixed betas.

AbsoluteJS beta.140: a dev page reconnects after a dropped connection without reloading, and keeps trying through long outages; edits to class and memo/forwardRef components show without a reload; production builds ship React's production build.
changes.summary: New projects use @absolutejs/absolute 0.20.0-beta.140: dev pages survive network drops

changes.detail: AbsoluteJS beta.139 makes Expo, React Native and the Expo code-signing tooling optional peers, so a new web project no longer installs them, nor node-forge and braces, which have high-severity advisories and no fixed release. `absolute mobile` installs them when a project adds an Expo app. beta.126 to beta.138 also bring the dead-stylesheet reload fix and `absolute typecheck` on `bun check`.
changes.summary: New projects use @absolutejs/absolute 0.20.0-beta.139: web projects no longer install Expo or React Native

changes.detail: AbsoluteJS beta.125 fixes Vue pages that reach a helper only through a re-export (`export { x } from "./y"`). Those helpers were never copied into the generated tree, so the page failed to build and answered 500 in dev.
changes.summary: New projects use @absolutejs/absolute 0.20.0-beta.125: Vue pages build through helper re-exports

changes.detail: AbsoluteJS beta.124 accepts `@absolutejs/auth` up to 0.96, so a project that adds a current auth no longer also gets auth 0.76.3 nested under AbsoluteJS. The duplicate had doubled the auth type declarations TypeScript loads. beta.124 also stops `/hmr-status` from counting closed or duplicate HMR clients.
changes.summary: New projects use @absolutejs/absolute 0.20.0-beta.124: one copy of @absolutejs/auth instead of two

New projects use @absolutejs/absolute 0.20.0-beta.123: React Fast Refresh works on a Bun with the reactFastRefresh fix (and `absolute dev` offers AbsoluteJS's patched Bun), edits keep applying after a React syntax error, and a React edit re-imports every changed module

Scaffold Prisma for every Prisma database (PostgreSQL, Neon, PlanetScale, CockroachDB, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Turso, SQL Server on Prisma 7.10 driver adapters; MongoDB on Prisma 6.19.3) with a committed initial migration, typed handlers and prisma generate / db:migrate scripts
Accept --orm none as the help text documents, and refuse unsupported database, host and ORM combinations before writing any files

Scaffold Drizzle for every Drizzle 1.0 dialect (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Turso/libSQL, SingleStore, SQL Server, CockroachDB) with a committed initial migration and db:generate / db:migrate scripts
Update registry dependency pins and generate compatible Elysia 2, Drizzle 1, Angular and HTMX starters with persistent auth, typed JSON subapps, and executable starter checks
Generate correctness-focused lint defaults with typed Drizzle checks and isolated Eden API subapps; consume eslint-plugin-absolute 0.12.0
Use the Elysia 2 error lifecycle verified against a fresh generated project
Generate the Elysia 2 onError lifecycle instead of an unsupported on error hook
